title: Check: Area of Parallelograms and Trapeziums (C)

questions.stem: Which formula correctly gives the area of a trapezium with parallel sides $a$ and $b$ and height $h$?
questions.explanation: The area of a trapezium is $\frac{1}{2}(a + b)h$, where $a$ and $b$ are the parallel sides and $h$ is the perpendicular height.
